required_outcomes: Records the landlord's approval with its terms: both the front and back doors, spend up to £250, and to be asked first if it will cost more.

Sends the job to the right trade (joiner or door and lock specialist) for both doors at the approved limit: assigns one, or returns the request to auto mode for provider selection, with the £250 cap and the fault described (frame wobble, has to be slammed, glass at risk).
Tells the tenant the landlord has approved and a contractor will be in touch to arrange a visit, with no invented date, and a safety note not to slam the glazed door meanwhile.
acceptable_alternatives: Confirming back to the landlord that the job is being arranged within £250.
Asking the tenant for access times while the contractor is arranged.
positive_behaviours: Corrects the category from Appliances to doors before the job goes to provider selection.
Treats the priority validation message as non-blocking and does not retry it.
red_flags: Escalating, or putting the request back on hold for the landlord, when approval is already given.
Sending an appliance engineer or leaving the Appliances category in place for provider selection.
prohibited_actions: Authorising spend above £250 without going back to the landlord.
Telling the tenant a visit date nobody has confirmed.
critical_failures: Leaving the approved job with no contractor instructed and the request not returned to provider selection.
